auto_insurance.label: Auto Insurance - mapped competitor references
auto_insurance.audience: US drivers comparing auto insurance rates after renewal increases, young-driver pricing, or full-coverage quote shock
auto_insurance.risk_framing: renewal increases, zip-code rating pressure, young-driver pricing, full-coverage affordability, and quick quote comparison
auto_insurance.cast_prompt: realistic adult US driver age 28-48 in a clean parked United States left-hand-drive car, driver seated on the left side, casual solid-color shirt, friendly expression, natural daylight, phone visible but angled away with no screen text, auto insurance UGC ad presenter, no logos, no text, no writing, no patterns
auto_insurance.cast_identity_description: the same realistic adult US driver from the reference photos, casual solid-color outfit, credible auto insurance shopper

mapped_young_driver_rate_check.label: Mapped - Young Driver Rate Check
mapped_young_driver_rate_check.script: If you are a new driver, or you have one on your policy, insurance can get expensive fast. Before you assume that is just the rate, compare a few options. Check your rate free.
mapped_young_driver_rate_check.tone: direct-to-camera UGC, helpful older sibling energy, practical and trustworthy, no hype
mapped_young_driver_rate_check.broll_action: @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car with a phone angled away, then gestures lightly as if explaining a simple rate check
mapped_young_driver_rate_check.broll_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic UGC-style auto insurance B-roll inspired by mapped Ad Library young-driver rate-check ads. @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car with a phone angled away from camera. Natural daylight, handheld creator framing, no readable text, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no dashboard text.

mapped_one_minute_quote.label: Mapped - One Minute Quote Check
mapped_one_minute_quote.script: I thought checking insurance meant calls and paperwork. It was just a quick quote check. See what options show up near you in under a minute.
mapped_one_minute_quote.tone: direct-to-camera UGC, lightly surprised, simple and credible, practical rate-shopping tone
mapped_one_minute_quote.broll_action: @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car, taps a phone angled away from camera, then looks back with a small surprised reaction
mapped_one_minute_quote.broll_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic UGC-style auto insurance B-roll inspired by mapped quick-quote competitor ads. @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car and checks a phone angled away from camera. Natural daylight, creator-shot framing, no readable phone text, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no dashboard text.

mapped_why_pay_more.label: Mapped - Why Pay More
mapped_why_pay_more.script: Why pay more for the same kind of coverage? A quick comparison can show whether your current rate still makes sense. Compare free quotes.
mapped_why_pay_more.tone: fast UGC PSA, confident but compliant, direct response pacing, no fixed savings claim
mapped_why_pay_more.broll_action: @driver stands near a parked United States car with keys in hand, then points briefly toward a phone as if showing a comparison step
mapped_why_pay_more.broll_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic UGC-style auto insurance B-roll inspired by high-impression compare-and-save ads. @driver stands beside a parked United States car in a driveway or parking lot with keys and a phone. Handheld creator framing, natural daylight, no readable text, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no license plate text.

mapped_renewal_shock_story.label: Mapped - Renewal Shock Story
mapped_renewal_shock_story.script: My renewal jumped and my record had not changed. That was the moment I stopped assuming loyalty meant the best rate. Check your options before the next bill.
mapped_renewal_shock_story.tone: short UGC confession, grounded and story-led, mildly frustrated but not dramatic
mapped_renewal_shock_story.broll_action: @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car holding a phone angled away, pauses as if reviewing a renewal notice, then looks back to camera
mapped_renewal_shock_story.broll_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic UGC-style auto insurance B-roll inspired by renewal-shock story ads. @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car with a phone angled away, showing a grounded reaction to a higher bill. Natural light, handheld creator framing, no readable phone text, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no dashboard text.

mapped_full_coverage_check.label: Mapped - Full Coverage Check
mapped_full_coverage_check.script: If you need full coverage, do not guess from one company's price. Compare options side by side before you decide. Start your quote.
mapped_full_coverage_check.tone: clear and practical UGC explainer, useful shopper advice, measured and trustworthy
mapped_full_coverage_check.broll_action: @driver stands next to a parked United States car, checks the car briefly, then looks at a phone angled away as if comparing coverage options
mapped_full_coverage_check.broll_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic UGC-style auto insurance B-roll inspired by full-coverage competitor ads. @driver stands beside a parked United States car in natural daylight and checks a phone angled away from camera. Clean background, no readable text, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no license plate text.

mapped_local_rate_review.label: Mapped - Local Rate Review
mapped_local_rate_review.script: Rates can change by area, even when your driving record stays clean. If your bill moved this year, compare what is available where you live. Check your rate.
mapped_local_rate_review.tone: local-feeling UGC PSA, credible neighbor tone, calm and specific without naming locations
mapped_local_rate_review.broll_action: @driver sits in the driver's left-side seat of a parked United States car in a neighborhood driveway, holding a phone angled away and speaking naturally
mapped_local_rate_review.broll_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic UGC-style auto insurance B-roll inspired by geo-localized rate-check ads. @driver sits in a parked United States left-hand-drive car in a residential driveway or local parking lot. Natural daylight, handheld creator framing, no readable text, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no dashboard text, no location signs.
